# Reviewed development candidate

`hollis-labs-plugin-host-ui-0.1.0.tgz` is an unpublished development candidate, built from Hollis Labs design-kit commit `dbcf4fa7f5bcfe83686d227b39ddf9426cea4fe5`, package `packages/plugin-host-ui`. MIT license is included in the archive. The source checkout was read-only. A repo-local copy received a standalone TypeScript config replacing workspace inheritance; runtime source bytes were unchanged.

SHA-256: `360c4bd74df7369d57af74151bba0ff0739b31b5c67499f1c01c15cefb4b24b0`.

The archive is intentionally committed for reproducible installs; it is not an npm release. Candidate source and build output are ignored. `frontend/src/chimera` preserves the typed integration example authored by Chimera in this session (MIT), from `frontend/src/{example,runtime,store,actions}` integration sources now published in Chimera commit `e8327a939965`; these copied TS integration sources are app-specialized with controlled scenario context and are not a published npm package, with app-owned region/isolation/action policy.
